title: El precio del imperio
goal: Read the paradox at the center of the colonial economy: the empire that received the most silver in world history arguably paid for it with its own long-term decline, while wealth stayed concentrated in very few hands.
grammar: Voz pasiva: consecuencias de la economía colonial

items: Explain why American wealth didn't translate into lasting development for Spain.
Explain what the 'price revolution' was and what caused it.
Contrast what England and the Netherlands did differently from Spain.
Explain who actually paid 'the price of empire', according to the reading.
Use a chain of passive-voice sentences to synthesize economic consequences.
